scope.is: documented/public/official spacecraft geometry and C_D basis for INTERIM PARAMETRIC drag studies

rfp_thrust_band.source: A9.13 S6.21 verbatim: 'The official RFP instead defines the functional orbit and thrust requirement: 180-230 km, intake specification dependent on air density/solar activity, and 12-25 mN thrust for expected drag compensation. RFP(1)'
rfp_thrust_band.note: RFP(1) is the owner-held RFP, not registered in the repository (AG-15). Shown for orientation only; it is not a drag result and the statewise gate is T_available(state) - D_spacecraft(state) >= 0 (S6.15).

records.label: REFERENCE/PARAMETRIC
records.name: ESA GOCE (flown; mission ended November 2013 per Romano 2018)
records.access: official public web page + open papers
records.applicability: reference spacecraft only; not the Vyovrinda host spacecraft (S6.18)

altitude_km.note: Romano: '250 (finally 235)-265 km SSO'. ESA page (verify): 'designed to skim above Earth at a height of just 250 km', 'mean altitude approximately 263 km'

mass_kg.note: ESA (verify): 'weighed in at about 1050 kg'; Romano: 'The S/C had a mass of 1050 kg'

length_m.note: same page gives 'slim 5 metre-long satellite' and '5.3 m long' (verify)

frontal_area_m2.note: SOURCE CONFLICT carried, not resolved: ESA page (verify) 'cross sectional area of about 1 m2' AND 'octagonal structure with fixed solar wings, 5.3 m long, cross-section of 0.8 m2'; Romano 2018: 'The frontal area was of 1.1 m2 [1]' (ref. [1] = GOCE CDR, not accessed). Interval [0.8, 1.1] m^2 spans all three statements

body_array_configuration.value: octagonal body; fixed (non-deployable) solar wings and winglets for aerodynamic stabilisation; no moving parts

attitude_assumption.value: flies along the velocity vector with the wings in the flow ('a configuration can be found in the GOCE spacecraft': solar arrays parallel to the direction of flight)

cd.note: no GOCE flight C_D value is stated in text or table by the sources read (Mehta 2022 plots it in Fig. 5; not digitized here). The 'GOCE-like' C_D = 3.7 of Vaidya (via Andreussi 2022: 'a reference GOCE-like spacecraft having a 1 m2 intake frontal area, a drag coefficient of 3.7') belongs to a different ABEP body and is carried only as REF-T1-VAIDYA / RC-VAIDYA-GOCELIKE

cd_model_basis.value: GSI used for GOCE density processing: diffuse reflection with incomplete accommodation (DRIA), energy accommodation alpha = 0.82 (constant)
cd_model_basis.source: SRC-MEHTA-2022 Sect. 2.2 (citing March et al. 2019b) and Sect. 5.1
cd_model_basis.note: Mehta: 'The GSIs were modeled as DRIA, where a was set to the carefully selected constant values of 0.85 and 0.82 for the CHAMP and GOCE satellites, respectively'; 'For GOCE, the largest difference in C D of about 10% is between DUT-DRIA-0.85 and RSM-CLL-WLK.' The GOCE C_D time series is only plotted (Fig. 5), not tabulated; not digitized here

records.a_ref_scope: body_without_intake (GOCE has no intake); the GOCE-like C_D = 3.7 case is a different body
records.note: GOCE thrust capability (ESA page, verify): 'throttled between 1 and 20 millinewtons'; Romano: 'thrust between T = 1.5 and 20 mN' - recorded for orientation only, not a requirement

findings.finding: abep_sim/mission_env.py Spacecraft defaults (bus_frontal_m2 = 0.25, bus_cd = 2.2, intake_cd_ref = 2.05) and spacecraft_drag() array C_D 2.4 carry no source in that module; this lane does not modify or call it. They are not REFERENCE/PARAMETRIC records and must not be quoted as a spacecraft drag basis
findings.action: owner/step-3 decision whether mission_env adopts a registered reference case (not done here)

findings.finding: GOCE frontal area is reported as about 1 m2 and 0.8 m2 on the same ESA page and as 1.1 m2 by Romano 2018 (citing the CDR); the conflict is carried as an interval
findings.action: none; no GOCE drag case is declared because no source pairs a GOCE flight C_D with its area

findings.finding: C_D spans 2.0-4.2 across the declared reference cases (C_D*A_ref 0.32-3.7 m^2); the sources read do not state the GSI/accommodation basis of most values, so the spread cannot be attributed to physics or convention and is not measurement scatter
findings.action: parametric studies evaluate all declared cases (envelope), no single 'representative' case

findings.finding: Several reference areas already contain the intake (Romano: A_f = A_in); naive addition of an F1 intake term double-counts
findings.action: enforced by the required intake_accounting argument

findings.finding: A closed-form Sentman flat-plate C_D (Sinpetru 2022 Eq. 6-7) was considered but not implemented: the incident-temperature definition is not recoverable from the text read, and implementing it from memory would violate rule 6
findings.action: open item; implement only from a fully read open source
